crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s angel came up from Gilgal to Bochim. He said, “I brought you out of Egypt, and have brought you to the land…
Thus Yahweh saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.
“When Jacob had come into Egypt, and your fathers cried to Yahweh, then Yahweh sent Moses and Aaron, who brought your…
“You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red Sea,
and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.
Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.
By faith, they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.
Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
So they struck him, with his sons and all his people, until there were no survivors; and they possessed his land.
He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings,
Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan,
The land had rest forty years, then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
After him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who struck six hundred men of the Philistines with an ox goad. He also saved…

translations.web: Yahweh said to the children of Israel, “Didn’t I save you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
